name: Sunray Waverly 3-Person Traditional Outdoor Sauna 300D2
description: Description The SunRay Waverly 3-Person Outdoor Traditional Sauna is designed for outdoor use with a shingled roof and durable construction. It features a 4.5 kW electric heater with lava rocks that produces steam heat up to 170°F. A 55-inch rear bench seat provides ample space for three users. The Waverly also includes front windows for natural lighting, a Bluetooth speaker system, sand timer, hygrometer, LED lighting, and a cask with spoon for steam generation.
